page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.medium is a compute-optimized instance powered by custom AWS Graviton ARM64 processors. This server features 1 dedicated physical core and 1 vCPU running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. It is equipped with 2.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, ensuring minimal virtualization overhead and dedicated resource allocation.

A key hardware feature of the c9gd.medium is its bundled local storage, consisting of a 59 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume. This local storage provides low-latency, high-speed read and write capabilities directly attached to the host. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture and dedicated single-core configuration offer a resource-dense profile for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the overhead of multi-threading. The inclusion of local NVMe storage makes it highly suitable for applications that require temporary high-speed scratch space. Appropriate workloads include lightweight containerized microservices, edge computing tasks, localized database caching, and basic web serving.
